slots.name: Burger King ranking
slots.sentence: The comeback has already started to pay off; Burger King recently overtook Wendy's as the number two burger chain in the U.S., based on system sales.

slots.sentence: In its latest quarter, Burger King reported domestic same-store sales growth of 8.5%, while McDonald's U.S. same-store sales rose just 0.8%.
